posts.description: (beautiful trees at Namiyoke Shrine)Sunday we went to Tsukiji so that Satoshi could check out some places for lunch on a Sunday, since he’ll be meeting up with a friend next SundayThe udon place we had lunch at wasn't on our list...it was junk. Plus I hate ordering by QR code especially when we are the only customers and you are just standing in front of me and are literally just watching us

posts.title: midnight diner spicy konnyaku
posts.description: The latest dish on the latest episode of "Midnight Diner" was spicy konnyakuSuper easy to makejust break the konnyaku into bite sized pieces with your handsput into a heated pan and after the water comes out from the konnyaku, add your soy based sauceI used dashi shoyu, a little sesame oil and chiliThere is also konnyaku with chili in it, but I haven't seen it in the stores recentlyAnyway, not

posts.title: thanks for today
posts.description: Friend Kurt is in town and contacted me to meet uphe left Japan in 2023 and has been back a couple of times but hadn't been able to meet uphe used to live and work in the Jiyugaoka area, so he was nostalgic for OotoyaAnd then we walked part of the Tokyo Institute of Technology campus where he also used to workI've passed this campus many times on my way to HimmelSince he wasn't in Japan when Koss
